sections.description:
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 10 OF 1991
PRESIDENT'S ORDER
10 OF 1991
TRANSFER OF HIGH
COURT JUDGES (ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1991
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 25th November, 1991]
No. F. 2(2)/91-Pub, dated
25-11-1991:-----The following Order made by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the Transfer of High Court Judges (Allowances and Privileges) Order, 1983 (P.O.
No.2 of 1983), for the purpose hereinafter appearing:
Now, Therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (2) of Article 200 of the Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make the following
Order, namely:-
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Order may be called the Transfer of High Court
Judges (Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Order, 1991.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the first day of June, 1991.
2. Amendment of Article 2,
P.O. No.2 of 1983:----In the Transfer of High Court Judges (Allowances and
Privileges) Order, 1983 (P.O. No.2. of 1983), in Article 2, for the words
"one thousand and Jive hundred rupees" the words "three thousand
rupees" shall be substituted.
